scope: Requirements supplied in stages05?19 plus reported map/keyboard UX. Earlier original01?04 prompts are unavailable in this conversation; reconcile their original acceptance criteria before declaring complete product traceability. Stage22 pilot consent, diagnostics, corridor rollback and honest readiness are mapped separately; no field execution claimed.

State machine and progress reject imprecise/stale/jumping GPS
Wrong-direction and off-route confirmation with bounded rerouting
Real maneuvers, no duplicate/stale/overlapping voice and honest limitations

Only current applicable verified limits are numeric; never substitute unknown
Heading, time, accuracy, parallel roads, ramps, junction and vehicle-class ambiguity
Sustained overspeed confidence, hysteresis, cooldown and safe wording
Verified transitions distinct from unverified reports; no invented camera coverage
Approximate incident reporting, spam/duplicate/vote moderation, expiry and privacy
Approved nearby updates, reconnect/backoff, freshness and no fake live traffic
Guest navigation, optional auth and locally saved places/preferences
Search clearing, account/local deletion, owner isolation and durable retry
Admin RBAC, current independent approvals, audit/revert and no unreviewed safety publication

English human review; Twi/Ga architecture stays unapproved until reviewed
Optional notifications, local Accra reminders, permissions, caps and no marketing/trip targeting
Free navigation, disabled sponsorship, separate ranking and private aggregate review foundation
Physical offline/radio/provider-outage acceptance versus simulated networking
Measured device battery/thermal/memory acceptance, not inferred from mocks
Security assessment and production monitoring with real evidence

Voluntary Accra pilot: default-off aggregate telemetry, safe protocol, independent corridor gates and honest monitoring/readiness

manualCases.title: APK installation, small-screen maps and startup
steps: Install the exact standalone candidate APK on three supported physical devices; record manifest minSdk, model, RAM, OS, signing/version identity and SHA256.
At 100% and 200% font/display scale, open map, locate, pinch/zoom, rotate heading and view the movement/stationary arrow; check gesture and three-button system navigation.
Repeat cold/warm startup ten times, denied and granted location, and search with keyboard open.
expected: No runtime/native crash, obscured bottom controls or hidden autocomplete. Route/action controls remain usable.
Record cold/warm startup and first-fix timings; goals are in STRATEGY.md, not claimed measurements.
evidence: Redacted screen recording for each device/settings combination

manualCases.title: Accra-friendly place search and provider failure
steps: While parked, search documented streets, markets, landmarks, junctions and suburbs with correctly/incorrectly spelled names; preselect real reference places.
Type quickly, clear, search again, disable network and exercise a controlled provider-error response in a test environment.
Open details/pin, select a real result and clear optional search history.
expected: Keyboard never hides accessible results; provider attribution and honest empty/unavailable states remain visible.
No invented landmark, stale query result, secret in logs or quota storm. Measure actual provider coverage; absence is not a fabricated result.

manualCases.title: Routes, alternatives and honest ETA
steps: Compare available genuine provider route alternatives, distance, selected polyline and maneuver geometry in staging.
Test no route, missing toll metadata, provider timeout/error and low bandwidth; try a saved route separately.
expected: Selected geometry matches destination and route choice; unknown tolls remain unknown.
Static ETA stays labelled an estimate. No traffic-aware Ghana claim or mock route in production.
evidence: Provider response/geometry reference with credentials removed

manualCases.title: GPS drift, jumps, stationary jitter and false speed
steps: Use synthetic/replayed GPS only in isolated tests, labelled test data: stale/future timestamps, 30-200m drift, teleport jumps, heading noise, and stationary speed jitter.
Run at least ten minutes of stationary/noisy sequences and a GPS loss/recovery cycle; observe counters and recorded app audio.
expected: No numeric applicable limit on ambiguous/imprecise fixes; no sustained bogus overspeed voice/UI warning.
No progress jump, repeated reroute or fake speed due to noise; quality recovers without hiding route geometry.
evidence: Synthetic replay file/hash and explicit TEST label
Fix-quality/progress observations without personal trip data

manualCases.title: Covered-area/tunnel GPS loss and recovery
steps: Use an actually available safe covered section/underpass or parked GPS attenuation test; identify which was used. A laboratory replay is not a real tunnel test.
Passenger observes entry, signal loss, stale location and exit recovery while driver follows signs independently.
expected: No fabricated movement, fresh speed or confirmed limit during GPS loss.
Map/route remain understandable, no bogus overspeed/reroute spam; guidance resumes only after reliable fixes.
evidence: Site type and lawful test plan

manualCases.title: Parallel roads, ramps, junctions and wrong direction
steps: Choose reviewed parallel-road/main-road/ramp/junction segments with independently documented reference geometry and limits; do not invent an Accra camera location.
Drive legally with passenger-operated devices; use a safe lawful route or closed-course replay to exercise wrong-direction detection. Never drive against traffic for testing.
Repeat ambiguous fixes near junctions and physical carriageways.
expected: No nearest verified road substitution onto a parallel carriageway. Ambiguity returns unknown.
Wrong-way confirmation/reroute does not instruct illegal or sudden manoeuvres; no rerouting loop.
evidence: Passenger annotated route observations, access controlled

manualCases.title: Unknown limits remain unknown and known limits have proof
steps: Prepare independently reviewed segment/class/direction/effective-date references before travel; if no verified coverage exists, test unknown behaviour and mark positive coverage blocked.
Passenger compares display and spoken text with applicable documented signs at legal speeds; test unsigned/unreviewed/expired/unmatched sections.
expected: Zero unknown-to-known substitutions, blanket80km/h defaults or unverified numeric limits.
Every displayed known limit has current applicable provenance; signs/rules override app guidance. A mismatch is a critical defect.
evidence: Timestamped observations linking segment and test build
Mismatch count and safety reviewer assessment

manualCases.title: Sustained overspeed, hysteresis and cue priorities
steps: Use isolated verified test fixtures and synthetic speed readings: threshold crossings, noisy boundary, sustained excess, return below threshold, mute, rapid repeats, stale proof and new segment.
Overlap upcoming maneuvers, arrival, verified warnings and community advisories; test missing TTS and audio interruptions. Never speed on public roads to trigger a warning.
expected: No warning for unknown/unverified limits or stale/imprecise GPS; genuine sustained test excess alerts once with documented cooldown.
No repeated/spam/overlapping voice; maneuvers have priority. Wording asks to slow down safely, never abrupt braking.
evidence: Labelled replay and expected state timeline
Captured cue/audio order and event counts

manualCases.title: Transitions and enforcement truth labels
steps: Passenger observes a reviewed speed-limit transition at legal speeds and separate unverified reported-road advisory if available.
Exercise expired, withdrawn, behind, wrong-direction and parallel-road enforcement metadata with staging replay where no real verified data exists.
expected: Only current verified applicable transitions/enforcement receive confirmed treatment.
Reported areas stay unverified road advisories, never confirmed precise camera pins; no invented mobile-camera or traffic-light coverage.
evidence: Source/review/direction evidence or explicit unavailable result

manualCases.title: Offline, partial download and Ghana radio switching
steps: Test explicit saved guidance, no saved route, fresh/stale/mismatched safety packs, partial/corrupt downloads, airplane mode and network restoration.
While parked or passenger-assisted, switch actual available2G/3G/4G/Wi-Fi radios; record carrier/availability. Separately shape bandwidth/latency/loss in the lab; do not call that a radio test.
Test cold app launch without Metro/network and repeated reconnect/backoff.
expected: Honest offline/stale status, no expired numeric limit, no false full-offline routing promise; previous complete downloads survive interruption.
No unbounded retries, duplicate streams or false live-traffic measurement. Unsupported radio or standalone cold launch is blocked, not passed.
evidence: Downloaded dataset version/expiry and reconnect timeline

manualCases.title: Battery, heat, memory and long sessions
steps: On each supported device run paired30-minute stationary-screen baseline and legal/passenger-observed navigation trials, three repeats, with matched brightness/radio/volume/ambient conditions and no charging.
Record battery percentage/power stats, temperature/thermal state, memory and crashes; end navigation and verify watches/speech stop. Include a90-minute navigation soak.
expected: No ANR, crash, runaway memory or critical thermal state.
Compare measured drain to the provisional20 percentage-points/hour ceiling and baseline; an excess needs investigation and signed decision, not a fabricated pass.
evidence: Per-device raw measurement sheet and controlled conditions
Soak recording and post-stop watcher evidence

manualCases.title: Permission denial, revocation and app lifecycle
steps: Deny/revoke foreground location and notification permission; test approximate-only location, GPS disabled, force-stop/reopen and background/foreground.
Test phone call/TTS interruption, Android battery saver and notification channel disabled; do not request background location implicitly.
expected: No crash, surprise permission loop or fabricated fix; navigation offers clear actionable recovery.
No background continuous history; old native builds fail gracefully. Notifications remain optional and navigation still works.

manualCases.title: Incident abuse, expiry, votes and privacy
steps: On isolated fixtures submit burst/duplicate reports, own/repeated/conflicting votes, spoofed stale fixes, oversized notes and expired hazards.
Check pending versus community-reviewed versus official labels; verify nearby stream expiry, backpressure and reconnect fallback.
expected: Rate/ownership checks hold; no client self-verification, unlimited extension or duplicate vote.
Approximate positions only; no reporter identity/precise travel history; stale/expired events disappear and remain separate from official alerts.
evidence: Sanitised API contract/load results and role table

manualCases.title: Clear history, delete data and durable retries
steps: With isolated accounts save Home/Work, history, an offline route, local renewal dates, notification registration and a report/vote.
Clear local data and delete account; interrupt network/provider deletion and reconnect. Check phone storage/native schedules, API ownership and provider result.
Check documented retained anonymous public hazards/audit/frequency-cap records separately; do not describe queued provider deletion as complete.
expected: No recoverable local saved locations/history/route/reminder plaintext or reusable removed credentials; native reminders are cancelled.
Account ownership and provider deletion complete or honestly pending with durable retry; no other account affected. Retention matches documentation.
evidence: Before/after storage/API checks using test accounts
Provider deletion confirmation or blocked retry evidence

manualCases.title: Security acceptance and source/role isolation
steps: Perform dependency/secrets review, abuse/authorization assessment and cross-account/cross-role checks against the exact candidate and deployment configuration.
Check admin cookies/CSRF, password-only role separation, evidence publication bypass, SQL reader privileges, HTTPS, secret redaction, request quotas and backup/restore.
expected: No unresolved critical/high finding; driver cannot gain admin rights, publish data or access another driver.
No provider/server keys in bundle/logs; provenance and current independent reviews required. Passing unit tests is not penetration-test certification.
evidence: Dated security report/SBOM/triage with false-positive rationale

manualCases.title: Accessibility and human English review
steps: Test TalkBack, colour-independent warnings, dark/light/glare,200% font, long real street names, safe tap targets and system bars on each physical device.
Human reviewers check all English screens, maneuvers, safety cues and Ghana pronunciation; unavailable Twi/Ga stay disabled.
Verify forms/keyboard defer during movement; passenger bypass expires and cannot weaken GPS confidence.
expected: No inaccessible safety text or hidden/end controls; no constant screen-reader chatter or overlapping app voice.
Real copy/pronunciation approvals reference the current catalogue; no fabricated translations or road validation claim.

manualCases.title: Optional notifications and local reminders
steps: Verify no prompt/collection by default, category opt-in, Accra09:00 renewal schedule, opt-out, permission/channel denial, reboot/timezone change and offline erase retry.

If remote delivery remains disabled, record that limitation; do not mark real FCM receipt/display as passed. If enabled later, test saved-region closures, reviewed policies, quiet hours, caps and invalid token receipts with test accounts.
expected: No marketing/current-trip profiling; dates stay on device; duplicate/expired/unapproved messages suppressed.
Provider receipt is not proof of phone display. Navigation voice/UI is not interrupted by promotional notifications.
evidence: Native schedule/phone receipt and timezone evidence
Remote disabled configuration or actual credentialed test delivery evidence

manualCases.title: Free navigation and sponsorship lock
steps: Attempt guest navigation and all safety functions without payment or sponsored consent.
Check every navigation state for sponsored UI/audio; inspect admin drafts/reviews and attempt public fetch/event/publication with viewer/editor/admin accounts.
expected: All navigation/safety stays free; zero pop-ups/audio/interstitial/promotional overlays.
Sponsorship delivery/tracking/billing stays locked; business data never influences route/safety ranking.
evidence: Admin/public endpoint and DB publication rejection evidence

manualCases.title: Production monitoring, outage alerts and rollback
steps: Use an approved staging failure drill for DB readiness, search/routing timeout, quota exhaustion, realtime outage, stale safety data and token/provider failure.

Prove production/staging synthetic checks, privacy-safe logs, crash/ANR observation, alert routing, named on-call ownership, response/rollback and source withdrawal. Obtain approval before paging people or causing outages.
expected: Health/readiness and aggregate metrics are useful but do not alone establish production monitoring.
A real controlled alert is acknowledged; dashboards/runbooks and rollback work without logging trips, credentials or raw GPS. No alert integration is claimed without evidence.
evidence: Monitoring configuration and redacted failure drill
Actual alert receipt/acknowledgment and rollback evidence
On-call owner, retention/access review and latency/error measurements

manualCases.title: Data expiry, migration and licensed provider review
steps: Test migration/restore on disposable PostGIS, then review source licences, review dates, effective dates, units/classes, source withdrawal and offline dataset expiration.
Verify real provider Ghana coverage, quotas, pricing and credentials for the intended use; no synthetic records enter production views.
expected: No expired/unreviewed/demo safety record becomes known; ambiguous ramps/parallel roads remain unknown.
Actual source and provider evidence exists; no assumed camera database, traffic licence or statutory80km/h default.
evidence: Migration/restore ledger and isolated contract results

manualCases.title: Real-road maneuver and voice acceptance
steps: Passenger observes legal normal driving on pre-reviewed urban, junction, suburb and highway sections; independently choose routes and signs before travel.
Check map startup, arrow heading, upcoming instruction, distance-to-turn, ETA estimate, recovery and arrival; compare actual road decisions to provider maneuvers.
Stop testing on unsafe instructions/distraction. Driver follows traffic signs and lawful safe driving, never the app in conflict.
expected: No unsafe turn instruction, frozen misleading speed/limit, hidden map/controls or repeated stale maneuver.
Each road/environment test is explicitly evidenced; no dependable lane guidance or Accra-wide coverage claim based on limited trials.
evidence: Passenger/tester names and safe route plan
Maneuver/arrival timing, discrepancies and safety review

manualCases.title: Pilot consent, native exits and deletion on real Android
steps: Install exact rebuilt APK on supported Android 11+ plus an unsupported/missing-native-module build; record identity and capabilities.

With diagnostics off, inspect traffic/native calls for no pilot collection; guest navigation remains available. Opt in separately, trigger controlled bench JS/native failure/ANR, restart and inspect only bounded daily counts. Never intentionally crash while driving.
While offline withdraw, restart, reconnect and verify remote erasure; race an upload, repeat account/phone deletion, inspect expired retention jobs and no resurrection.
expected: No coordinates/routes/history/identifiers/error text in diagnostic payloads; no pre-consent events.
Unsupported/missing/truncated/gap evidence is unavailable, never zero-crash proof; platform error handling remains intact.
Counters clear, pending deletion is honest and retries, new receipts deduplicate and revoked credentials cannot upload.
evidence: Exact APK/build/SHA256, physical OS/device and redacted network/native verification.
Independent tester/reviewer findings, encrypted storage/remote deletion and scheduler evidence.

manualCases.title: Accra pilot independent corridor and staffed rollback drill
steps: Two real independent reviewers validate documentary signs/road direction/class/geometry and current corridor revision; verify no test fixtures enter real data.
Passenger-assisted legally operated tests stay within approved corridor; record unknown/ambiguous behaviour, voice/GPS/network safety and structured minimised feedback.
Pause corridor, expire/withdraw evidence and exercise global service flags safely; measure polling/context delay and confirm pilot cached offline safety cannot restore a number.
Verify staffed support, participant withdrawal, privacy/hosting/provider approval and response communication before invitation.
expected: Unapproved/stale/ambiguous/outside-corridor limits remain unknown; stage metadata never substitutes for review or cohort access control.
No dangerous manoeuvres or driver forms; clear consent and no default movement analytics.
Rollback timing, escalation owner and remaining unknowns are recorded honestly; any critical issue blocks advancement.
evidence: Independent road/source/corridor review package and exact-build passenger evidence.
Sanitised support case, pause audit, timed rollback, staffed contact and legal/operations sign-off.

gates.tolerance: Zero false known limits; any mismatch blocks release.

gates.name: No unverified enforcement presented as confirmed
gates.tolerance: Zero mislabelled confirmed markers or spoken claims.

gates.name: No sustained bogus overspeed warnings or unsafe guidance
gates.tolerance: Zero sustained bogus alerts or unsafe route instructions; any critical event blocks.

gates.name: Data deletion works and retention is honest
gates.tolerance: No undeclared retained personal data or falsely completed deletion.

gates.name: Security and privacy checks accepted
gates.tolerance: No unresolved critical/high finding or unauthorized access/publication.

gates.name: Production monitoring and response evidenced
gates.tolerance: Actual approved alert/acknowledgment/rollback drill and named owner required.

gates.name: Device, radio, accessibility and resource acceptance
gates.tolerance: Exact standalone APK, representative physical devices and current human review; no unexecuted pass.
